title: Microsoft Brings Claude in Copilot Inside the EU Data Boundary
dek: European firms get Anthropic's Claude without giving up data residency.

facts.label: Claude's default setting in EU and EFTA

caption:
Europe's biggest objection to using Claude at work is on its way out. 🇪🇺

Microsoft says Anthropic's Claude models in Microsoft 365 Copilot will process data inside the EU Data Boundary for EU and EFTA customers, targeting the end of 2026. That covers Copilot experiences like Copilot Cowork, and existing Claude users will be moved over automatically with no action needed.

Why it matters: banks, insurers, healthcare providers and public bodies often can't approve AI that sends data outside the region. Claude stays off by default in Europe, but admins can now switch it on without the data-residency trade-off.

At AI Parabellum, we see this as a clear signal that Microsoft treats Claude as a core part of Copilot, not a side option.

Compliance teams that blocked Claude over data location, this one's for you.

Microsoft is moving Claude in Copilot inside its EU Data Boundary by the end of 2026, under the same enterprise data protection and admin controls as its other Copilot models.
